import re

def extract_value(raw):
    s = str(raw).strip()
    if s == "" or s == "None" or s == "[]":
        return ""
    m = re.search(r'=\s*([^}\]]+)', s)
    if m:
        return m.group(1).strip()
    return s

merchant_id = extract_value(vars.get("merchantId"))
preferred_currency = extract_value(vars.get("preferredCurrency")) or "USD"
dpu_merchant_account_id = extract_value(vars.get("dpuMerchantAccountId"))
dpu_limit_application_id = extract_value(vars.get("dpuLimitApplicationId"))

vars.put("merchantId", merchant_id)
vars.put("preferredCurrency", preferred_currency)
vars.put("dpuMerchantAccountId", dpu_merchant_account_id)
vars.put("dpuLimitApplicationId", dpu_limit_application_id)

log.info("save merchantId=" + merchant_id)
log.info("save preferredCurrency=" + preferred_currency)
log.info("save dpuMerchantAccountId=" + dpu_merchant_account_id)
log.info("save dpuLimitApplicationId=" + dpu_limit_application_id)

import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone

preferred_currency = vars.get("preferredCurrency")
if preferred_currency is None or preferred_currency == "":
    preferred_currency = "USD"

event_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
datetime_utc = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
last_updated_on = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
charge_bases = "Fixed" if preferred_currency == "CNY" else "Float"

vars.put("eventId", event_id)
vars.put("underwrittenOriginalRequestId", "req_" + event_id.replace("-", ""))
vars.put("datetime_utc", datetime_utc)
vars.put("lastUpdatedOn", last_updated_on)
vars.put("chargeBases", charge_bases)

suffix = str(vars.get("dpuLimitApplicationId") or event_id.replace("-", ""))
vars.put("lenderCreditId", "lcredit_" + suffix)
vars.put("lenderLoanId", "lloan_" + suffix)
vars.put("lenderRepaymentScheduled", "lrs_" + suffix)
vars.put("lenderRepaymentId", "lrepay_" + suffix)

if vars.get("underwrittenAmount") is None or str(vars.get("underwrittenAmount")) == "":
    vars.put("underwrittenAmount", "500000")
